incident-bot: TABLETOP EXERCISE — simulated page for high error rate on embeddings in eu-central-1. THIS IS A DRILL. No production traffic affected. Paging oncall: @leah.

incident-bot: alert payload (simulated):
```
alert_id: TBX-EMB-002
service: redwood-inference/embeddings
region: eu-central-1
metric: 5xx_rate_percent
threshold: 1.5
current: 6.8
start_time: 2026-03-11T09:21:50Z
notes: simulated client-side throttling + proxy misconfig during deploy
```

leah (oncall): ack — taking tabletop. Quick triage: logs show increased 502/504s from proxy layer, client retries spiking. Not seeing model OOMs. @tom can you run probe of proxy pods and rate limit config?

tom (eng-sre): running simulated checks. Findings (drill):
- proxy ingress pods rotated due to config push 10m before alert
- rate-limit rule reverted to default (lower) causing upstream queueing
- no token-exhaustion errors from model-serving nodes

rita (product): while you triage, let's exercise customer comms flow. We need: a status page blurb, a targeted customer email for enterprise tier, and a short support DM template. Keep customer email formal and include remediation steps and ETA.

josh (support): I'll draft the support DM template for engineers on the customer side: short, actionable, include headers & link to status.

josh (support): SUPPORT DM draft (simulated):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,
Were investigating elevated error rates affecting embeddings in eu-central-1. We've opened a status page incident: <status link>. Recommended immediate workarounds: (1) retry with exponential backoff, (2) route requests to eu-west-1 if latency allows.
Were working on a fix and will update within 30 minutes.
Regards, Josh, Redwood Support
```

nina (devex): public status page draft — keep it non-technical, include impact, scope, and mitigation ETA. Also note affected SDK versions only if confirmed.

nina (devex): STATUS PAGE DRAFT (simulated):
```
We are investigating increased error rates for embedding requests from the eu-central-1 hosted region. Some requests may receive 5xx responses or experience higher retry rates.
Whos affected: Customers using embeddings in eu-central-1. "Dedicated-only customers on private infra unaffected."
What we're doing: Rolling back a recent proxy config change and routing traffic away from impacted ingress nodes.
ETA: 20-40 minutes (simulated).
```

rit a (product): small nit: "Private and dedicated deployments not using the eu-central-1 hosted ingress are not affected." might be confusing; suggest "Private and dedicated deployments not using the eu-central-1 hosted ingress are not affected."

leah (oncall): thanks — updated status draft and posted simulated incident: https://status.redwood.example/drills/TBX-EMB-002 (DRILL).

incident-bot: simulated status posted. Remember: for drills we time the end-to-end: alert -> status post -> customer email approval -> support snippet share.

tom (eng-sre): mitigation (simulated steps):
1) rollback proxy config: `redwoodctl proxy apply --config previous`
2) cordon two ingress nodes and drain with staggered delay
3) temporarily increase proxy timeout to reduce 502s for inflight requests

tom (eng-sre): simulated commands used:
```bash
# rollback (simulated)
redwoodctl proxy set-config --region eu-central-1 --from-snapshot snap-20260311-0910
# cordon & drain
kubectl cordon proxy-ingress-2
kubectl drain proxy-ingress-2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

leah (oncall): monitoring metrics. If error rate doesn't fall to <1% after rollout, plan B is to fail traffic to eu-west-1 for enterprise customer tenants; need product sign-off for targeted routing. @rita please confirm the customer notification cadence for enterprise customers.

rita (product): agree to targeted routing as plan B for affected enterprise tenants. For the simulated exercise, let's practice sending an enterprise email. EMAIL DRAFT (simulated):
```
Subject: [Redwood] Simulated incident: embeddings errors in eu-central-1 
Hi <CustomerTeam>,
We are conducting a simulated incident response exercise regarding elevated error rates for embeddings requests in eu-central-1. No customer data or production traffic is impacted.
If you were affected, immediate mitigations would include routing traffic to eu-west-1 and applying client-side retries with jitter. Our teams would follow up with a full incident summary after resolution.
Estimated resolution window: 20-40 minutes (simulated).
Regards, Rita (Product)
```

josh (support): good. For the real runbook, we should include a checkbox: "enterprise email approval required from product" and a streamlined template to avoid delays. In this drill it took ~8 minutes to iterate wording.

nina (devex): internal comms dry-run: short engineer-facing update + executive note. Provide one-liners for Slack and one for email.

nina (devex): INTERNAL UPDATE (simulated):
```
Slack: Simulated: high embedding 5xxs in eu-central-1. Mitigation in progress (proxy rollback + node drain). Owner: leah.
Email to execs: Simulated incident in eu-central-1 causing embedding errors. No production impact (drill). Mitigation being executed; will follow up with post-mortem and action items.
```

ops-lead-bot: Drill reminder: capture timings: alert->ack, ack->status post, status->support template, support->enterprise approval. Please add timestamps to the drill log.

leah (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay on for another 20m, then handoff to tom for monitoring & post-mortem write-up. Handoff criteria: error rate <1% for three consecutive 1m windows, and support templates published.

tom (eng-sre): taking over after 20m. For the PM, let's capture exact commands used and time-to-rollout; also include retrospective item: make proxy config deploy an atomic change with canary by default.

rita (product): retro notes: customer comms approval was the bottleneck. Action: pre-approve short enterprise templates and designate a product comms backup oncall.

josh (support): support action: I'll create a shared Confluence snippets page and link it in #incidents-drills-retro. Will add draft templates for enterprise emails and support DM.

nina (devex): also propose a simple checkbox in the runbook for drills: "simulate targeted customer email" so we exercise that workflow every quarter.

leah (oncall): Drill complete (simulated) — main takeaways:
- status post time: ~4m from ack (good)
- enterprise email approval slowed us ~8m (need pre-approvals)
- runbook needs explicit routing owner for plan B
- add canary-by-default requirement for proxy config deploys

incident-bot: TABLETOP COMPLETE — please complete the drill feedback form: https://forms.example/drills-feedback?drill=TBX-EMB-002 and file retro items in #incidents-drills-retro.

ops-lead-bot: Good exercise. I've logged action items: pre-approved email templates, add runbook checkbox for customer-email simulation, and implement canary flag on proxy deploys.

josh (support): adding draft snippets to Confluence tonight, will ping this channel with link tomorrow.

nina (devex): thanks team. Great to rehearse the comms handoffs.

leah (oncall): logging off. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
